publisher: Direccion General de Contrataciones Publicas (DGCP), Portal transaccional
government_level: national - all central + local agencies on the Transactional Portal
scope_summary: Central + local agencies that use the Transactional Portal.
exclusions: Purchases paid from petty-cash funds (a fund of at most RD$50,000; each expense at most RD$5,000) - a funding mechanism, not a value floor; terminated contracts (termination <= 40% of total); foreign-service office construction/acquisition; exclusive/single-supplier goods & services (law 340-06).
threshold: None: no value floor. Small purchases are published (e.g. 'Compras por Debajo del Umbral', 'Contratacion Menor').
quality_notes: Contracts fan out (~1.22/award) - standalone contract table; has bids/details; no tender/lots; awards carry no value (money in contracts/bids).
